name: surplate
description: Surplate: connect bakeries' surplus food with the people who can use it.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
